decision_conditions: By virtue of the cumulative scale and bulk and the first floor flat roofed design the proposed rear extension would result in a dominant, incongruous and visually obtrusive form of development which would cause significant harm to the character, appearance and visual amenities of the pair of semi-detached dwellings and the surrounding area, contrary to Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One- Strategic Policies (2012), Policies DMHB 11 and DMHB 12 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two- Development Management Policies (2020), Policies D1, D3 and D4 of the London Plan and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The applicant is advised that the submitted plans are inaccurate in terms of the annotation of the first floor accommodation and the floorplans and elevations are inconsistent in terms of the proposed side facing windows.

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
description: Erection of a part single storey, part two storey side and rear extension.
